protocol.purpose: isolated winding-coordinate cache experiment, not adoption acceptance or Orca scoreboard
protocol.job: supports-off Benchy Arachne; ticket-44 attribution settings, current post-repair baseline
protocol.order: AB then BA, alternating by pair; ordinary batch then accelerated batch
protocol.exactness: both proof pairs must pass before either timing batch; every output equals fresh baseline byte-for-byte

starvation.discard: exclude entire pair if either arm is below its own cutoff; no automatic resampling

protocol.keep: both modes require lower median wall and process CPU, with negative paired median deltas
